identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Industrial Precision with Organic Sustainability.
Data Density: Every pixel must serve a purpose. No fluff.
Visible Structure: Expose the grid. Show the skeleton.
Contrast is King: High contrast for safety and readability.

heading.usage: Page titles, Section headers, KPI values

mono.usage: Code snippets, Batch IDs, Hash values

rules: KPI numbers must be massive (text-4xl to text-6xl).
Labels must be uppercase, small (text-xs), and wide tracking (0.1em).

primary.description: Deep Evergreen - The anchor. Use for primary actions, active states, and brand headers.

secondary.description: Safety Orange - Use for alerts, critical actions, and 'hotspot' indicators.

background.description: Zinc-100 for app background, White for cards/surfaces.

accent.description: Pale Emerald - Use for positive trends and success states.

gradients.rule: No gradients. Use solid, flat colors or subtle noise textures.

rules: No rounded corners on internal grid items. Max rounded-md on outer containers.
Dense information density: Use h-full to stretch items.

cards.style: Flat, white background, 1px border (border-zinc-200), no shadow by default.

inputs.style: bg-white, border-zinc-300, rounded-sm. Focus: ring-2 ring-primary/20 ring-offset-0.

charts.style: Minimalist. No grid lines inside charts unless necessary. Tooltips must be high contrast (black bg, white text).

hero.usage: Login page background, Dashboard empty states

raw_materials.usage: Raw Materials Master Data section header

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Dark colors must be solid, not gradients.
Use glass-morphism sparingly (only for sticky headers).
Micro-animations are mandatory for all interactive elements.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-precision Industrial ESG Dashboard. Prioritize data density and clarity. Use the 'Grid Borders' layout strategy where every section is defined by visible lines. Use the provided images for context. Follow the color palette strictly - Deep Evergreen is your anchor.
